prompt:
The following bash function has bugs. Expected behaviour: sum_col FILE COL prints the sum of the integer values in column COL (1-based) of the comma-separated FILE, skipping the first (header) line. The last line of the file may not end with a newline.
Return the corrected function in a single ```bash code block, no explanations.

```bash
sum_col() {
  local file=$1 col=$2 total=0
  while IFS=, read -r -a f; do
    total=$((total + f[$col]))
  done < "$file"
  echo $total
}
```
